output_list.criticism: The function getBalance is public and anyone can call it, which may lead to unauthorized access to the contract's balance.
The function withdraw is public and anyone can call it, which may lead to unauthorized access to the contract's balance.
The function getLastTicketTime is public and anyone can call it, which may lead to unauthorized access to the contract's last ticket time.
The function AddTicket is public and anyone can call it, which may lead to reentrancy attacks.
The function PayWinner is public and anyone can call it, which may lead to reentrancy attacks.
